title: This $42M 'AI' Shopping App Was Secretly Hundreds of Humans
alt_title_1: DOJ & SEC: 'Autonomous AI' Checkout App Used Call Centers
alt_title_2: Inside the Federal Indictment of AI Shopping Startup Nate
description_hook: In April 2025, the U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of New York and the SEC charged the former CEO of shopping app startup Nate, alleging the company raised over $42 million on claims of autonomous AI checkout while contractors in the Philippines and Romania manually placed orders.

affiliate_cta.offer_name: Free 5-Hour Asset Builder OS + reading list
affiliate_cta.pinned_comment: How many '100% AI' startups today are quietly running on manual labor behind the curtain? Full SDNY indictment PDF is in the description.

scenes.headline: Raised $42M for 'AI' Checkout
scenes.narration: Federal prosecutors and the SEC charged the former CEO of shopping app Nate after raising over 42 million dollars on claims of autonomous AI.
scenes.source: U.S. Attorney's Office S.D.N.Y. & SEC LR-26282 (Apr 2025)

scenes.headline: Claimed 93% to 97% AI Success
scenes.narration: The indictment alleges investors were told proprietary neural networks finished checkouts in seconds with 93 to 97 percent accuracy.
scenes.source: U.S. v. Albert Saniger Indictment Para. 5, p. 3 (S.D.N.Y.)

scenes.headline: Humans Typed Orders Overseas
scenes.narration: Prosecutors allege the app's actual AI automation rate was effectively zero, and hundreds of contractors in the Philippines and Romania placed orders manually.
scenes.source: U.S. v. Saniger Indictment Count One, p. 1 (S.D.N.Y.)

scenes.headline: Scripts, Not Autonomous AI
scenes.narration: Even its limited bots allegedly used site-specific scripts, not AI. These are indictment charges, and the defendant is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.
scenes.source: U.S. v. Saniger Indictment Para. 7-8, p. 4 (S.D.N.Y.)

scenes.headline: Audit Live Inputs, Not Demos
scenes.narration: Never trust a rehearsed AI demo when money is on the line. Test the product live with your own messy, unscripted inputs.
